Include the file content in the output. This will increase the time taken to fetch the files and might cause issues with large files. If a download fails the event still arrives, carrying a File Content Error instead of the content.
Trigger when a file is created or update: Trigger when a file is created or updated, checked on a schedule. Each event carries a Change Type of created or updated, and several edits between two checks arrive as a single event. Renaming a file counts as an update. Trashing a file is not an event, and neither is restoring one from the bin nor moving an existing file into the watched folder. Selecting a parent folder watches its direct children only, not sub-folders.
